mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_report (report_no, answer_session_id, result_code, cover_url, result_snapshot, generated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{reportNo}, #{answerSessionId}, #{resultCode}, #{coverUrl}, #{resultSnapshot}, #{generatedAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_report r INNER JOIN t_answer_session s ON s.id = r.answer_session_id AND s.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN t_test_version v ON v.id = s.version_id AND v.deleted = 0 WHERE s.open_id = #{openId} AND s.answer_type = 1 AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT r.id AS report_id, s.id AS answer_session_id, v.test_id, v.version_no, v.title, COALESCE(r.cover_url, v.cover_url) AS cover_url, CASE WHEN access.id IS NOT NULL THEN r.result_code END AS result_code, CASE WHEN access.id IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_snapshot, '$.resultName')) END AS result_name, r.generated_at FROM t_report r INNER JOIN t_answer_session s ON s.id = r.answer_session_id AND s.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN t_test_version v ON v.id = s.version_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_report_access access ON access.report_type = 1 AND access.report_id = r.id AND access.open_id = s.open_id AND access.deleted = 0 WHERE s.open_id = #{openId} AND s.answer_type = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.generated_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
